description: This source file implements battery degradation simulation functions, including cycle aging, calendar aging, and profile aging, by calling methods from the Cycler class and related configurations. It defines functions for simulating individual experiments and batch processing with multi-threading support.

methods.name: Cycle_one
methods.description: Simulates one cycle aging regime by configuring a cell and calling the cycler’s cycleAgeing method, with error handling.

methods.name: Calendar_one
methods.description: Simulates one calendar aging regime by configuring a cell and calling the cycler’s calendarAgeing method, with error handling.

methods.name: CycleAgeing
methods.description: Runs multiple cycle aging experiments in parallel, configuring different cycle parameters and executing them.

methods.name: CalendarAgeing
methods.description: Runs multiple calendar aging experiments in parallel, configuring different resting conditions and executing them.

methods.name: ProfileAgeing
methods.description: Runs multiple drive cycle aging experiments in parallel, configuring different drive cycle profiles and executing them.
